name: @eslint/jskit
description: A fast, ESLint-compatible parser, scope analyzer, and control flow analyzer for JavaScript and TypeScript.

scripts.bench: npm run build && node benchmarks/parse/benchmark.js && node benchmarks/scope/benchmark.js
scripts.bench:chart: npm run build && node benchmarks/parse/benchmark.js --json=benchmarks/parse/results.json && node benchmarks/parse/chart.js benchmarks/parse/results.json benchmarks/parse/results.svg
scripts.conformance: npm run build && node scripts/parse/conformance-js.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-tokens.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-ts.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-types.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/derive-shapes.mjs && node scripts/scope/conformance-js.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/scope/conformance-ts.mjs ../../node_modules 5000
scripts.conformance:parse: npm run build && node scripts/parse/conformance-js.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-tokens.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-ts.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/conformance-types.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/parse/derive-shapes.mjs
scripts.conformance:scope: npm run build && node scripts/scope/conformance-js.mjs ../../node_modules 5000 && node scripts/scope/conformance-ts.mjs ../../node_modules 5000
